summary: First kernel-door contact for every hypercar manifest row (13 rows: aero, body, brakes, chassis, details, glazing, hinge, interior, lighting, powertrain, suspension_front, suspension_rear, wheels). Mechanical census, PB-011C protocol applied exactly as FH-CENSUS applied it: one fresh python process per run, serial, quiet machine. The ten rows with a recorded corpus/ttc/reference/<row>.json were run through corpus/ttc/door.py --engine truck (kernel door, door_version 2): NONE returns kernel geometry facts - every row stops in AUTHORING on a typed refusal (8 rows: Spline profile authoring x4 [aero, body, chassis, glazing], explicit Plane frame x2 [hinge, powertrain], non-pure-z Location placement x2 [brakes, wheels]) or an untyped kernel-door DNF (2 rows: interior Plane.XY frame constant AttributeError; lighting Vector.normalized AttributeError). No boolean/composition op is reached by any row, so the hypercar boolean-blocked set is empty and the green set is empty on this dispatch; the rows' booleans-on-swept-carriers SKIPS reason graphs stay unreachable until an authoring-surface lift lands. Three rows (details, suspension_front, suspension_rear) have NO recorded reference (their reference-file short names are occupied by same-named f1 rows) - the UNSTAGED stop condition fired and they were not run. OCC-baseline door evidence (door_version 1, one fresh process per row, serial) for the ten staged rows is 10/10 green and reproduces the recorded references bit-identically (no OCC-DNF); the census table carries that per-row evidence (solid_count, STL triangles, OCC door wall_s) exactly as PB-011C's F1 verdict table did. No row carries a lift marker; anchors A1=48/A2=1 hold on corpus/ttc/MANIFEST.json (unchanged - no corpus edits).

stop_conditions.occ_dnf: did not fire (10/10 OCC runs green)

findings.title: The hypercar family is authoring-blocked at a richer surface than the FH/F1 families
findings.detail: FH-CENSUS rows stopped at the census verbs revolve/extrude/sweep; the hypercar rows stop one or two carriers earlier on profile/frame/placement authoring the truck regime answers typed (Spline profile bands, explicit Plane frames, non-pure-z Location placements) or fails on untyped (Plane.XY/Plane.XZ frame constants, Vector direction methods). None of the ten staged rows reaches its first loft/revolve verb or any boolean, so the kernel executor's boolean/admission state is never exercised by a hypercar row on this dispatch.

findings.title: Two rows fail untyped because the census data model's attribute surface is thinner than the corpus's client-layer algebra
findings.detail: interior reaches for bd.Plane.XY and lighting for Vector.normalized; neither is on the drop-in data row. As with the FH tube() rows, these are defects the authoring-arm program (F1-AUTHORING-ARMS extrude/tube() scope) should close by answering the frame-constant and direction-math attributes or refusing them typed.

findings.title: Three hypercar rows are unstaged: their reference-file short names collide with same-named f1 rows
findings.detail: hypercar/details, hypercar/suspension_front and hypercar/suspension_rear have no recorded hypercar/* reference (reference/details.json, reference/suspension_front.json, reference/suspension_rear.json belong to the f1 rows), so the coverage map carries a 3-row gap the next corpus-recording step must close before those rows can be run against the kernel door.

findings.title: OCC-baseline references for all ten staged hypercar rows reproduce bit-identically
findings.detail: 10/10 OCC door runs green, facts equal to the recorded doubles; row solids range 10-440, STL 1229-325242 triangles. The green-side admission program has a trustworthy baseline to compare against once the authoring surface lifts.

notes: docs/HYPERCAR_CENSUS.md carries every hypercar manifest row's verdict (10 typed-refusal / kernel-door-DNF + 3 UNSTAGED), no gaps, anchors holding (A1 48, A2 1 on the unchanged MANIFEST). Typed refusals are valid outcomes (measurement, not a lift packet); no row was tuned, no corpus script was edited, no benchmark timing was performed, and no concurrent door runs were made. The doc table reproduces the PB-011C per-row verdict shape with the OCC-baseline door-evidence columns (solid_count, STL tris, wall_s) exactly as PB-011C produced for the F1 family.
